title: Tabs
description: The white thumb slides between tabs, and the panel switches with it.
usage: For peer sections of one object. Keep to 2–5 tabs with short labels. Put one [data-tabpane] per tab after the tab list, in tab order.
a11y: WAI-ARIA APG tabs with automatic activation. The list is a tablist, buttons are tabs with aria-selected and aria-controls, and each [data-tabpane] is a tabpanel labelled by its tab; unselected panels are hidden. Only the selected tab is in the Tab order; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move and select (visual direction, so reversed in RTL) and wrap, Home/End jump. A panel without focusable content takes focus so Tab reaches it. A kata-tabs-change event (bubbling, detail.index) reports changes. Instances initialize independently and loading the script twice is safe. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
